text: 港股IPO新动向！香港证监会重拳出击3个IPO操纵案，修改上市规则强化监管 这3家港股上市公司分别为茶百道（02555.HK）、拨康视云（02592.HK）、天聚地合（02479.HK）。
text_en: New trend in Hong Kong IPOs! Hong Kong SFC cracks down on 3 IPO manipulation cases, amends listing rules to strengthen regulation; the 3 Hong Kong-listed companies are ChaPanda (02555.HK), Cloudbreak Pharma (02592.HK), and Tianju Dihe (02479.HK).
